name: Etsy Listing Photo Prep — Resize, White-Background & Platform-Ready Images in One Batch
description:
How do I get my Etsy photos listing-ready in one batch — right sizes, clean white backgrounds where they belong, metadata stripped, and the whole folder 67% smaller like on the test set? Drop in a folder of product photos; get back a folder you can upload as-is.
ImageBatch runs on your own computer: no uploading your catalogue to someone else's server, no per-image credits. Etsy presets lead; Shopify, square and web presets are built in too.
WHAT IT DOES
• Auto-orients photos from their EXIF tag (no more sideways listings), then strips ALL metadata
• Resizes to the preset: Etsy · square-padded 2000×2000 · Shopify 2048 · web 1600
• Converts between JPG / PNG / WebP; flattens transparency cleanly for JPG
• Optional sequential renaming (shop-01, shop-02, …) so uploads stay in order
• A per-file report: before/after dimensions and bytes, and how much smaller the folder got
THE HONEST PARTS
• It never upscales. A 800×600 photo flagged "below zoom threshold" tells you the truth instead of selling you a blurry 2000px fake.
• Originals are never modified. Outputs go to a new folder.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Test folder (4000×3000 photo, EXIF-rotated photo, transparent PNG): resized to 2048×1536, rotated upright, flattened onto white, metadata gone from every file, 67% smaller overall.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload limits, no per-image credits, no subscription. Process ten photos or ten thousand for one payment.
Windows 10/11, nothing else to install.
Scope: file mechanics (size, orientation, format, metadata) — not retouching or background removal.
